AI Cross Matrix (ACM) is a privacy-centric financial protocol that enables decentralized, cross-chain, and untraceable asset transfers. It uses zero-knowledge proofs, ring signatures, and AI-driven path obfuscation to ensure end-to-end anonymity and secure transaction routing for Web3 finance.

SparkChain AI is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) that leverages unused internet bandwidth and compute resources to power AI infrastructure. It aims to democratize access to high-performance AI by providing a scalable, cost-effective, and censorship-resistant compute layer for developers, researchers, and enterprises.

Sealcoin is building a decentralized machine-economy platform that enables IoT devices and AI agents to autonomously authenticate, exchange data, and settle payments. This platform, built on Hedera DLT and powered by the QAIT token, aims to eliminate human intervention in machine-to-machine transactions.

Antier Solutions is a blockchain and Web3 development company that provides enterprise-grade decentralized solutions. They specialize in crypto exchange development, DeFi protocols, and NFT marketplaces for businesses worldwide.

Voran is a decentralized computing platform building crypto-native infrastructure for scalable, cost-efficient compute services. It focuses on supporting AI workloads and the emerging AI agent economy through tokenized physical infrastructure and globally distributed computing resources.

Warden Protocol is an AI-native Layer 1 blockchain that enables developers to build Intelligent Applications. It provides verifiable access to AI models to power on-chain and off-chain logic, combining programmable key management and policy-based authorization.

Block Security Arena (BlockSecX) offers an AI-powered Web3 security platform for blockchain developers and users. It aims to close the security gap in Web3 by providing gamified education, advanced tooling, and a decentralized bug bounty ecosystem to protect against vulnerabilities.
